encoding_variations: interest_rate is catalog percent with no coercer — store the numeric value ('6.875'); note the unit is percent-per-annum, coerced downstream as needed
rate_type (enum, null): 'Fixed', 'Adjustable', 'ARM' — governs whether margin_and_caps / change_dates_and_index should be non-null
subject_property_indicator (boolean) — this note is filed because it is a non-subject property; the value should read false-for-subject, but capture the stated basis, degraded to str
note_city_and_state is the '[City], [State]' line at the top of the note form, distinct from property_address

open_questions.q: subject_property_indicator as bool — degrades to str (no bool coercer).
options: add a bool coercer or a controlled string
open_questions.recommendation: if an REO/DTI rule is built, confirm whether a bool coercer or a controlled string is wanted so the non-subject test is deterministic

open_questions.q: ARM fields flattened — margin_and_caps / change_dates_and_index are objects flattened to str.
open_questions.recommendation: if ARM re-underwriting ever needs the components typed, they'd need sub-field promotion

open_questions.q: DTI consumer — monthly_principal_and_interest is typed on the expectation of a future DTI/liabilities rule.
open_questions.recommendation: confirm the intended snapshot_path and whether taxes/insurance (full PITI) are needed rather than P&I alone

notes: No rules in the packet -> no rule floor. This is the promissory note for a non-subject property (retained/departure/investment). Its mortgage relevance is the monthly payment obligation that flows into DTI, plus confirmation it is not the subject property. The subject_property_indicator and monthly_principal_and_interest are the fields a future DTI/REO rule would read.
No new _PII_FIELDS entries. loan_number (confidential) treated as identity/linkage. borrower_name/lender_name are names retained as typed identity. No SSN/DOB/account number on a note.

allonge_or_endorsement (object[]) and rider_or_addendum_references (string[]) genuinely repeat but neither is read by a rule; endorsements/allonges are chain-of-title detail and riders are references — both fall to the catch-all. A note has one set of terms, not a repeating schedule.
Prompt hint (doc-level): money stays a string in value, coerced to Decimal on read.
